title: Born in Springfield
description: Jenny Gillespie was born in Springfield, Illinois. She grew up in a creative, introverted household environment and developed an early love of poetry and music.

title: Grew up in charismatic Christian church
description: Jenny grew up attending a charismatic Christian church, which shaped the spiritual atmosphere of her childhood and adolescence.

title: Began writing poetry and songs
description: As a teenager, Jenny became deeply interested in poetry and songwriting, developing a creative identity centered on literature and music.

title: Attended UVA creative writing workshop
description: Jenny attended a creative writing workshop at the University of Virginia and took a songwriting workshop, an experience that catalyzed her commitment to songwriting and performance.

title: Started recording and performing publicly
description: Jenny began recording songs at a local studio and performing at coffeehouses and music festivals in St. Louis and Memphis while still in high school.

title: Parents divorced
description: Jenny's parents divorced around the time she turned eighteen, marking the end of Springfield as a lasting family home base.

title: Started University of Virginia
description: Jenny moved to Charlottesville to study English Literature at the University of Virginia. She focused on poetry and literature while continuing to write songs and perform at coffeehouses.

title: Moved to Austin for graduate school
description: Jenny moved to Austin to pursue a master's degree in English Literature and Creative Writing. She continued writing, performing, and recording music during graduate school.

title: Moved to Chicago
description: Jenny relocated to Chicago and became immersed in the city's folk and literary communities, performing in coffeehouses and developing her songwriting.

title: Worked at Cricket Magazine
description: Jenny worked as an editor at Cricket Magazine while continuing to write poetry and make music.

title: Recorded music at Electrical Audio
description: Jenny recorded music at Electrical Audio in Chicago as she developed a more public folk music practice.

title: Left editorial work to pursue poetry and music
description: Jenny left her editorial career to focus more fully on poetry, music, and creative work.

title: Pursued MFA in poetry
description: Jenny pursued an MFA in poetry while deepening her commitment to creative life and music.

title: Ran Native Cat Recordings
description: Jenny ran the record label Native Cat Recordings while touring and recording as Sis.

title: Began producing music in Ableton
description: Jenny began producing and recording her own music at home using Ableton, marking a major creative shift toward self-production and experimentation.

title: Released music across multiple projects
description: Jenny released recordings under Sis, Ship Says Om, and Jenny Gillespie Mason, expanding into ambient, electronic, and folk forms.

title: Discovered Integral Yoga
description: Jenny discovered Integral Yoga and became devoted to the teachings of Sri Aurobindo and the Mother, marking a major spiritual turning point.

title: Traveled alone to India
description: Jenny traveled to India alone for spiritual exploration and study related to Integral Yoga.

title: Began publishing essays on Integral Yoga
description: Jenny began writing and publishing essays on Integral Yoga through her Substack, integrating spirituality and creative work.
